data.body: ORCHESTRATOR TRIAGE (2026-08-29): Held for an operator SECURITY-DESIGN decision before any fix is dispatched. The mechanism (SSM SecureString values persisted in cleartext in terraform state, collapsing the secret tier to the state-bucket ACL) is a genuine defect, but the remediation is a design choice, not a mechanical fix — options include moving secrets out of terraform-managed state (create-ignore_changes + out-of-band seeding), a dedicated secrets manager, or hardening state-at-rest/ACL posture. Each changes the deployment/secret-handling contract. Awaiting operator direction on the target posture; will dispatch a /rebar-debug repair once the design target is set.
